decisions.reason: The large bulk container launched only in 2024 has its own page and fits the firm's core packaging business, so its value is still uncertain and keeping it costs little, which favors holding the option open.
The valve complements the bulk container line and has its own page, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized, so the cheap option should stay open.

The take-back service is only mentioned on the website and its prospects are still unresolved, but it supports circular-economy and EU packaging regulation needs at low holding cost, so it is worth keeping as an option.
